title: A corrupt save falls back to very old v1 progress
description: Sweep D, confirmed in code: storage.ts read() returns null for unparsable JSON, and loadSave then reads the v1 keys (strata.progress.v1) if present, which are never deleted after migration. So a corrupt or null strata.save.v2 on a phone that once ran a pre-v2 build rolls the player back to that old level and shows What's new. save-data.md says corrupt JSON gives a fresh save. Decide: delete the v1 keys after migrating, and/or only migrate v1 when no v2 key exists at all. Rare. Evidence: sweep/d/loads/corrupt-with-v1.png

title: No 'progress can't be saved' notice when storage is blocked outright
description: Sweep D (strata-n5n), confirmed in code: when reading window.localStorage throws (blocked site data), src/ui/storage.ts defaultStore() returns null, so writeSave's store?.setItem never throws and the onSaveError toast (TD-14) never shows; the offline-ready toast is also suppressed. The player plays with nothing saved and is never told. Full storage (setItem throws) works: one toast at boot. Repro: Object.defineProperty(window,'localStorage',{get(){throw new DOMException('denied','SecurityError')}}) before load. Evidence: sweep/d/all/probe-getterThrows-after-setting.png

title: Milestone Share button cut off on the win card at 320 px / 150% text
description: Found by eye in sweep B (strata-40v) screenshots shots/small150-win-level.png and small150-win-daily.png: at 320x568 with 150% text, the badge row's small Share (sharing 3.4, src/ui/screens/win.ts momentButton, style .win-shell .moment-share) runs past the right edge of the win card and is clipped to 'Shar'. Likely the same on the set-complete row. Fine at Pixel 7 (production/qa/evidence/sprint-14/h4-moments/). Expected: the button stays inside the card (wrap under the text, or shrink the text column). The automated overflow check missed it because the card clips it.

title: Challenge target comes back on a later replay of the same level
description: Found in sweep C (strata-kfi), confirmed by code: state.versus is set in src/ui/screens/friend.ts:35 and only cleared in src/ui/screens/board.ts:124 when a DIFFERENT level starts; never on a win or on going Home. Steps: open ?challenge=5&pours=999 on a level-20 save, Play, win level 5, go Home, replay level 5 from the map. Expected (sharing.md 3.2): no 'Beat 999' target, no verdict, Share reads 'Challenge a friend'. Actual: the target, verdict and 'Send it back' return.

title: Sweep A leftovers: stuck banners, weekly 2-5 and bonus, Perfect win, daily replay
description: Not run in sweep A: the stuck and 'can't be won' banners in the browser (400 random taps never got stuck), weekly boards 2-5 and the 100-coin set bonus, a Perfect win (+10), Shuffle with no useful move, the daily replay card. Generation 1-700 (+999, 5000, 10000), debut cards, boosters and prices, first clears and the map replay all checked and working. Two leads were not bugs: weekly Continue returns to the weekly sheet by design (weekly-set.md 3.8), and dropped special jars on levels 360/512/559/699 are the designed fallback (GA-LG-6; stone cards only announce debuts).

title: Measure generation time of late levels (500+) on a phone
description: Sweep A (strata-qkq): levels 512, 559 and 699 take 1.1-1.4 s to generate on the dev container (desktop class); a phone may be 3-5x slower. Levels are normally prefetched in the worker (src/ui/gen-worker.ts) while the player is on Home or the previous board, so this only shows when the prefetch misses (a map replay of a late level, a ?level= link). Players reach 500 only after months. Measure on a real phone; if it shows, cap the fallback chain's attempts for 500+. Evidence: scratchpad sweep/a/gen-351-700.txt, gen-retime.txt (not in the repo).

title: An update that arrives while a sheet is open over Home waits until a board is played
description: Sweep D, confirmed in code (introduced in PR #33): src/ui/update.ts applyUpdateIfSafe runs on controllerchange and in showHome only. If the new version takes over while Settings (or any sheet) is open over Home, closing it returns to Home without reloading; the update waits until the player starts and leaves a board. Fix: also check when a layer closes back to Home (layers top becomes homeEl). Evidence: sweep/d/all/update-settings-closed.png, all/result.json updSettings

title: A save code holding [] is accepted and restores a fresh save
description: Sweep D, confirmed in code: storage.ts isObj accepts arrays, so importSave('STRATA1:W10=') (base64 of []) is accepted as 'level 1 with 100 coins' and Restore wipes progress (after the confirm tap). save-data.md says a code that is not an object is invalid. Fix: isObj must reject arrays (check the other callers). Evidence: sweep/d/all/code-array-*.png

title: Decide: a challenge on the receiver's current level pays as a first clear
description: Found in sweep C. sharing.md 3.2 says Play 'starts level N as a replay', but friend.ts starts the receiver's own next (uncleared) level as a normal first clear, paying the usual coins and moving them on. Either the doc or the code should change; it is not a sharing reward. Owner decision.

title: Hand-edited saves: missing tutorialDone and a bad level are not inferred
description: Sweep D: a v2 save without tutorialDone gives the tutorial even at level 45 (the v1 path infers it from level), and level -5 resets to 1 while best and perfect up to 44 are kept. Only reachable by editing or corrupting a save. Also cosmetic: coins 1e300 shows as '1e+300'. Backlog unless the owner wants it. Evidence: sweep/d/loads/missing-fields.png, neg-level.png, huge.png
